newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Monday. There were no sales of slaughter steers or heifers confirmed at the close.

Inquiry was fair, demand was light. Week-to-date including late Friday and over the weekend 1,000 head confirmed. Last sales Friday, Feb 14, select and choice steers and heifers $64.00. Mondays asking prices mostly $66.00, bids few $63.00.
